references.text: Rebekah gives Abraham's servant water to drink, a similar act of hospitality where a woman provides a thirsty traveler with a drink
God opens Hagar's eyes so she sees a spring of water to quench Ishmael's thirst, thematically linked to thirst and drinking
Deborah's song describes the same event where Jael gave Sisera milk when he asked for water
The continuation of the story where Jael kills Sisera after giving him a drink and covering him up
Abraham offers hospitality to the three visitors, including milk, a similar theme of offering drinks to guests
